stem: Which physiological type of cerebral palsy is the most prevalent, occurring in $80-90\%$ of cases?
explanation: Spastic cerebral palsy, caused by damage to the motor cortex or corticospinal tracts, is the most common form.
rationale: Think of the term used to describe muscles that appear stiff or tight due to motor pathway damage.

optionExplanations.A: Ataxic cerebral palsy, characterized by balance issues, is much less common than the spastic form.
optionExplanations.B: Dyskinetic cerebral palsy involves involuntary movements and is not the most common physiological type.
optionExplanations.C: Spastic cerebral palsy, caused by damage to the motor cortex or corticospinal tracts, is the most common form.
optionExplanations.D: Mixed types involve multiple motor patterns but do not represent the vast majority of cases individually.
